import ReluLayer.PTX.DotLoop
import ReluLayer.PTX.ReluSuffix

namespace ReluLayer.PTX

variable {layout : Layout} {rows : Nat}

/-- Block four: initialized dot loop followed by bias/ReLU/store/return. -/
def bodyProgram (width : Nat) : List (Instruction Register) := dotLoop width ++ reluSuffix

def bodySteps (width : Nat) : Nat := dotLoopStart + dotIterationSteps * width + reluSuffix.length

/-- The complete computational block returns with the specified output and preserved frame. -/
structure BodyResult (ops : FP32.Arithmetic) (data : TensorData layout rows)
    (buffers : Buffers) (i : Fin rows) (initial final : State Register) : Prop where
  pc : final.pc = (bodyProgram layout.inputWidth).length
  returned : final.returned = true
  column : final.regs .column = BitVec.ofNat 32 layout.inputWidth
  result : final.regs .result = rowResult ops data i
  memory : OutputStored ops data buffers i initial.globalMemory final.globalMemory
  other32 : ∀ r, r ≠ .column → r ≠ .weightValue → r ≠ .inputValue →
    r ≠ .accumulator → r ≠ .biasValue → r ≠ .result → final.regs r = initial.regs r
  other64 : ∀ r, r ≠ .weightRead → r ≠ .inputRead → final.regs64 r = initial.regs64 r
  otherPredicates : ∀ r, r ≠ .more → final.predicates r = initial.predicates r

/-- Actual concatenated-program execution, reusing the loop and suffix theorems. -/
theorem body_correct (ctx : ExecutionContext) (data : TensorData layout rows)
    (buffers : Buffers) (i : Fin rows) (initial : State Register)
    (hentry : BodyEntry layout rows buffers data i initial) :
    ∃ final, run (bodyProgram layout.inputWidth) ctx (bodySteps layout.inputWidth) initial = some
        final ∧ BodyResult ctx.ops data buffers i initial final := by
  obtain ⟨middle, hloop, hinv⟩ :=
    dotLoop_correct ctx data buffers i initial hentry
  have hb : middle.regs64 .biasRead = elementAddress buffers .bias i.val :=
    (hinv.other64 .biasRead (by decide) (by decide)).trans hentry.biasRead
  have hy : middle.regs64 .outputWrite = elementAddress buffers .output i.val :=
    (hinv.other64 .outputWrite (by decide) (by decide)).trans hentry.outputWrite
  have hsuffix : SuffixEntry ctx.ops data buffers i middle (dotLoop layout.inputWidth).length := by
    refine ⟨?_, hinv.active, hinv.accumulator, hb, ?_, hy⟩
    · simpa [dotLoopExit, dotLoop] using hinv.pc
    · rw [hinv.memory]; exact hentry.inputs.bias i
  obtain ⟨final, hs, hr⟩ := reluSuffix_correct_at (dotLoop layout.inputWidth)
    ctx data buffers i middle hsuffix
  have hl := run_append_of_run (dotLoop layout.inputWidth) reluSuffix ctx (dotLoopStart +
      dotIterationSteps * layout.inputWidth) initial middle hloop
  refine ⟨final, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold bodyProgram bodySteps
    rw [run_add, hl]
    exact hs
  · constructor
    · simpa [bodyProgram] using hr.pc
    · exact hr.returned
    · exact (hr.other32 .column (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)).trans hinv.column
    · exact hr.result
    · simpa only [hinv.memory] using hr.memory
    · intro r hc hw hx ha hb hresult
      exact (hr.other32 r hb ha hresult).trans (hinv.other32 r hc hw hx ha)
    · intro r hw hx
      rw [hr.regs64]; exact hinv.other64 r hw hx
    · intro r hmore
      rw [hr.predicates]; exact hinv.otherPredicates r hmore

end ReluLayer.PTX

import ReluLayer.PTX.BaseLoading
import ReluLayer.PTX.BodyExecution
import ReluLayer.PTX.ProgramComposition

namespace ReluLayer.PTX

variable {Reg : Type}

/-- The three setup blocks retain their independent instruction lists. -/
def kernelSetup (cfg : Launch) (layout : Layout) : List (Instruction Register) :=
  baseLoading ++ rowSelection cfg.threads ++ addressCalculation layout.inputWidth

/-- The computational block's absolute branch targets include the setup offset. -/
def kernelProgram (cfg : Launch) (layout : Layout) : List (Instruction Register) :=
  kernelSetup cfg layout ++
    (bodyProgram layout.inputWidth).map (Instruction.relocate (kernelSetup cfg layout).length)

def kernelSteps (cfg : Launch) (layout : Layout) : Nat :=
  (kernelSetup cfg layout).length + bodySteps layout.inputWidth

/-- Supplied parameters, successful address conversions and initialized input words. -/
structure KernelEntry (cfg : Launch) (layout : Layout) (env : Environment)
    (args : Argument → Word64) (buffers : Buffers) (data : TensorData layout cfg.rows)
    (initial : State Register) : Prop where
  pc : initial.pc = 0
  active : initial.returned = false
  parameters : ∀ arg, env.params arg.symbol = some (args arg)
  conversions : ∀ arg, env.toGlobal (args arg) = some (buffers arg)
  inputs : InputsStored layout cfg.rows buffers data initial.globalMemory

/-- The final stored result, with internal register/PC bookkeeping left to block contracts. -/
structure KernelResult (cfg : Launch) (layout : Layout) (ops : FP32.Arithmetic)
    (data : TensorData layout cfg.rows) (buffers : Buffers) (t : Thread cfg)
    (initial final : State Register) : Prop where
  returned : final.returned = true
  result : final.regs .result = rowResult ops data t.rowIndex
  memory : OutputStored ops data buffers t.rowIndex initial.globalMemory final.globalMemory

private theorem shift_reset (s : State Reg) (offset : Nat) (h : s.pc = offset) :
    State.shiftPC offset { s with pc := 0 } = s := by
  cases s; simp_all [State.shiftPC]

private theorem wideProduct_row (row : Word32) (stride : Nat) (h : stride < 2 ^ 32) :
    wideProduct row (BitVec.ofNat 32 stride) = BitVec.ofNat 64 (row.toNat * stride) := by
  simp [wideProduct, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h]

/-- Each launched thread executes all four blocks and stores its specified row result. -/
theorem kernel_correct (cfg : Launch) (layout : Layout) (hfit : cfg.rows ≤ 2 ^ 32)
    (ctx : ExecutionContext) (data : TensorData layout cfg.rows)
    (args : Argument → Word64) (buffers : Buffers) (t : Thread cfg)
    (hid : ctx.id = t.identity)
    (initial : State Register) (hentry : KernelEntry cfg layout ctx.env args buffers data initial) :
    ∃ final, run (kernelProgram cfg layout) ctx (kernelSteps cfg layout) initial = some final ∧
      KernelResult cfg layout ctx.ops data buffers t initial final := by
  obtain ⟨bases, hbase, hb⟩ := baseLoading_correct ctx args buffers initial
    hentry.pc hentry.active hentry.parameters hentry.conversions
  let rowInitial := { bases with pc := 0 }
  obtain ⟨rowFinal, hrow, hrr⟩ :=
    rowSelection_correct cfg hfit t rowInitial rfl
      (hb.active.trans hentry.active) ctx hid
  have hractive := hrr.active.trans (hb.active.trans hentry.active)
  let addressInitial := { rowFinal with pc := 0 }
  obtain ⟨addressFinal, haddress, ha⟩ := addressCalculation_exec layout.inputWidth
    ctx addressInitial rfl hractive
  let bodyInitial := { addressFinal with pc := 0 }
  have hmemory : bodyInitial.globalMemory = initial.globalMemory :=
    ha.memory.trans (hrr.memory.trans hb.memory)
  have hselected : (addressInitial.regs .row).toNat = t.row := hrr.row
  have hweights : addressInitial.regs64 .weightBase = buffers .weights :=
    congrFun hrr.regs64 .weightBase |>.trans (hb.bases .weights)
  have hbias : addressInitial.regs64 .biasBase = buffers .bias :=
    congrFun hrr.regs64 .biasBase |>.trans (hb.bases .bias)
  have houtput : addressInitial.regs64 .outputBase = buffers .output :=
    congrFun hrr.regs64 .outputBase |>.trans (hb.bases .output)
  have hinput : addressInitial.regs64 .inputRead = buffers .input :=
    congrFun hrr.regs64 .inputRead |>.trans (hb.bases .input)
  have hbodyEntry : BodyEntry layout cfg.rows buffers data
      t.rowIndex bodyInitial := by
    refine ⟨?_, rfl, ha.active.trans hractive, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [hmemory] using hentry.inputs
    · exact (congrArg (fun regs => (regs .row).toNat) ha.regs32).trans hrr.row
    · change addressFinal.regs64 .weightRead = _
      rw [ha.weights, hweights, wideProduct_row _ _ layout.stride_fits, hselected]
      simp [weightAddress, Layout.rowStride]
    · exact ha.inputRead.trans hinput
    · change addressFinal.regs64 .biasRead = _
      rw [ha.bias, hbias, wideProduct_row _ _ (by decide : fp32Bytes < 2 ^ 32), hselected]
      rfl
    · change addressFinal.regs64 .outputWrite = _
      rw [ha.output, houtput, wideProduct_row _ _ (by decide : fp32Bytes < 2 ^ 32), hselected]
      rfl
  obtain ⟨bodyFinal, hbody, hbr⟩ := body_correct ctx data buffers
    t.rowIndex bodyInitial hbodyEntry
  -- Lift each existing block execution to its actual PC in the concatenated kernel.
  have hrowAt := run_relocate baseLoading (rowSelection cfg.threads) ctx (rowSelection
      cfg.threads).length rowInitial rowFinal hrow
  rw [shift_reset bases baseLoading.length (by simpa [baseLoading] using hb.pc)] at hrowAt
  have hrowFull := run_append_of_run (baseLoading ++ rowSelection cfg.threads)
      (addressCalculation layout.inputWidth ++
      (bodyProgram layout.inputWidth).map (Instruction.relocate (kernelSetup cfg layout).length))
          ctx (rowSelection cfg.threads).length bases (rowFinal.shiftPC baseLoading.length) hrowAt
  have haddressAt := run_relocate (baseLoading ++ rowSelection cfg.threads) (addressCalculation
      layout.inputWidth) ctx (addressCalculation layout.inputWidth).length addressInitial
      addressFinal haddress
  have haddressStart : addressInitial.shiftPC (baseLoading ++ rowSelection cfg.threads).length =
      rowFinal.shiftPC baseLoading.length := by
    simp [addressInitial, State.shiftPC, baseLoading, rowSelection, hrr.pc]
  rw [haddressStart] at haddressAt
  have haddressFull := run_append_of_run (kernelSetup cfg layout) ((bodyProgram
      layout.inputWidth).map (Instruction.relocate (kernelSetup cfg layout).length)) ctx
      (addressCalculation layout.inputWidth).length (rowFinal.shiftPC baseLoading.length)
      (addressFinal.shiftPC (baseLoading ++ rowSelection cfg.threads).length) haddressAt
  change run (kernelProgram cfg layout) ctx (addressCalculation layout.inputWidth).length
      (rowFinal.shiftPC baseLoading.length) = _ at haddressFull
  have hbodyAt := run_relocate (kernelSetup cfg layout) (bodyProgram layout.inputWidth) ctx
      (bodySteps layout.inputWidth) bodyInitial bodyFinal hbody
  have hbodyStart : bodyInitial.shiftPC (kernelSetup cfg layout).length =
      addressFinal.shiftPC (baseLoading ++ rowSelection cfg.threads).length := by
    simp [bodyInitial, State.shiftPC, kernelSetup, baseLoading, rowSelection,
      addressCalculation, ha.pc]
  rw [hbodyStart] at hbodyAt
  have hbaseFull := run_append_of_run baseLoading (rowSelection cfg.threads ++ addressCalculation
      layout.inputWidth ++
      (bodyProgram layout.inputWidth).map (Instruction.relocate (kernelSetup cfg layout).length))
          ctx baseLoading.length initial bases hbase
  have hbfull : run (kernelProgram cfg layout) ctx baseLoading.length initial = some bases := by
    simpa only [kernelProgram, kernelSetup, List.append_assoc] using hbaseFull
  have hrfull : run (kernelProgram cfg layout) ctx (rowSelection cfg.threads).length bases =
      some (rowFinal.shiftPC baseLoading.length) := by
    simpa only [kernelProgram, kernelSetup, List.append_assoc] using hrowFull
  refine ⟨bodyFinal.shiftPC (kernelSetup cfg layout).length, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hsteps : kernelSteps cfg layout = baseLoading.length +
        ((rowSelection cfg.threads).length +
          ((addressCalculation layout.inputWidth).length + bodySteps layout.inputWidth)) := by
      simp [kernelSteps, kernelSetup, baseLoading, rowSelection, addressCalculation]; omega
    rw [hsteps, run_add, hbfull, Option.bind_some, run_add, hrfull, Option.bind_some,
      run_add, haddressFull, Option.bind_some]
    exact hbodyAt
  · constructor
    · exact hbr.returned
    · exact hbr.result
    · simpa only [State.shiftPC, hmemory] using hbr.memory

end ReluLayer.PTX

import ReluLayer.PTX.Machine

namespace ReluLayer.PTX

variable {Reg : Type}

/-- Embedding a fragment changes only its PC, never its data state. -/
def State.shiftPC (offset : Nat) (s : State Reg) : State Reg :=
  { s with pc := offset + s.pc }

/-- Absolute branch targets move with the fragment. -/
def Instruction.relocate (offset : Nat) : Instruction Reg → Instruction Reg
  | .branchIf predicate target => .branchIf predicate (offset + target)
  | inst => inst

private theorem execute_relocate [DecidableEq Reg] (offset : Nat) (inst : Instruction Reg)
    (ctx : ExecutionContext) (s : State Reg) :
    (inst.relocate offset).execute ctx (s.shiftPC offset) =
      (inst.execute ctx s).map (State.shiftPC offset) := by
  cases inst <;>
    simp [Instruction.relocate, Instruction.execute, State.shiftPC, State.writeNext,
      State.write64Next, Operand.read, Operand64.read, Option.map_map, Function.comp_def,
      Nat.add_assoc]
  all_goals first | rfl | split <;> simp_all

private theorem step_relocate [DecidableEq Reg]
    (prelude program : List (Instruction Reg)) (ctx : ExecutionContext) (s : State Reg) :
    step (prelude ++ program.map (Instruction.relocate prelude.length)) ctx (s.shiftPC
        prelude.length) =
      (step program ctx s).map (State.shiftPC prelude.length) := by
  have hoff : ¬ prelude.length + s.pc < prelude.length := by omega
  simp only [step, State.shiftPC, hoff, List.getElem?_append, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left,
    List.getElem?_map]
  cases ha : s.returned <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Option.map_none]
  cases h : program[s.pc]? with
  | none => simp
  | some inst => simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some]; simpa [State.shiftPC, ha] using
      execute_relocate prelude.length inst ctx s

/-- A successful fragment run embeds after any prelude, with PC and branches relocated. -/
theorem run_relocate [DecidableEq Reg]
    (prelude program : List (Instruction Reg)) (ctx : ExecutionContext) (fuel : Nat)
    (s final : State Reg)
    (h : run program ctx fuel s = some final) :
    run (prelude ++ program.map (Instruction.relocate prelude.length)) ctx fuel (s.shiftPC
        prelude.length) = some (final.shiftPC prelude.length) := by
  induction fuel generalizing s with
  | zero => simpa [run] using congrArg (Option.map (State.shiftPC prelude.length)) h
  | succ fuel ih =>
    obtain ⟨next, hs, ht⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp h
    rw [run, step_relocate, hs, Option.map_some, Option.bind_some]
    exact ih next ht

end ReluLayer.PTX

import ReluLayer.PTX.BodyExecution

open ReluLayer.PTX

private def layout : Layout := ⟨2, by decide, by decide⟩
private def buffers : Buffers
  | .weights => 0
  | .input => 16
  | .bias => 24
  | .output => 32
private def data : TensorData layout 2 :=
  ⟨fun i j => BitVec.ofNat 32 (i.val * 2 + j.val + 1),
    fun j => BitVec.ofNat 32 (j.val + 5), fun i => BitVec.ofNat 32 (i.val + 7)⟩
private def memory : GlobalMemory := fun a =>
  if a = 0 then some 1 else if a = 4 then some 2
  else if a = 8 then some 3 else if a = 12 then some 4
  else if a = 16 then some 5 else if a = 20 then some 6
  else if a = 24 then some 7 else if a = 28 then some 8
  else if a = 32 then some 0x3f800000 else none
private def initial : State Register :=
  { regs := fun r => if r = .row then 1 else 99
    pc := 0
    regs64 := fun r => match r with
      | .weightRead => 8 | .inputRead => 16 | .biasRead => 28 | .outputWrite => 36 | _ => 999
    globalMemory := memory
    predicates := fun _ => true }
private def ops : FP32.Arithmetic := ⟨fun w x acc => acc * 10 + w + x, fun a b => a + b⟩

private theorem entry : BodyEntry layout 2 buffers data 1 initial := by
  constructor
  · constructor <;> decide
  all_goals decide

private def executed : Option (State Register) :=
  run (bodyProgram 2) ⟨⟨0, 0⟩, Environment.empty, ops⟩ (bodySteps 2) initial

-- The appended program crosses the loop/suffix boundary with no PC reset.
example : ((run (bodyProgram 2) ⟨⟨0, 0⟩, Environment.empty, ops⟩ 18 initial).map
    (fun s => (s.pc, s.returned, (s.regs .accumulator).toNat))) = some (10, false, 90) := by decide
example : executed.map (fun s => (s.pc, s.returned)) = some (15, true) := by decide
example : executed.map (fun s => ((s.regs .column).toNat, (s.regs .result).toNat)) = some (2, 98) := by decide
example : executed.bind (fun s => s.globalMemory 36) = some 98 := by decide
example : executed.bind (fun s => s.globalMemory 28) = some 8 := by decide
example : executed.bind (fun s => s.globalMemory 32) = some 0x3f800000 := by decide
example : executed.map (fun s => ((s.regs .row).toNat, (s.regs64 .biasRead).toNat,
    (s.regs64 .outputWrite).toNat)) = some (1, 28, 36) := by decide
example : ∃ final, run (bodyProgram 2) ⟨⟨0, 0⟩, Environment.empty, ops⟩ (bodySteps 2) initial = some final ∧
    BodyResult ops data buffers 1 initial final :=
  body_correct ⟨⟨0, 0⟩, Environment.empty, ops⟩ data buffers 1 initial entry

-- The generalized suffix theorem also applies after a non-loop prelude.
private def prelude : List (Instruction Register) := [.mov .row (.imm 1), .mov .column (.imm 2)]
private def suffixInitial : State Register :=
  { initial with pc := prelude.length, regs := fun r => if r = .accumulator then 90 else initial.regs r }
private theorem suffixEntry : SuffixEntry ops data buffers 1 suffixInitial prelude.length := by
  constructor <;> decide
example : ∃ final, run (prelude ++ reluSuffix) ⟨⟨0, 0⟩, Environment.empty, ops⟩ 5 suffixInitial = some final ∧
    SuffixResult ops data buffers 1 suffixInitial final prelude.length :=
  reluSuffix_correct_at prelude ⟨⟨0, 0⟩, Environment.empty, ops⟩ data buffers 1 suffixInitial suffixEntry

#print axioms run_append_of_run
#print axioms reluSuffix_correct_at
#print axioms body_correct

private def expectedSource : String :=
  let lines := (bodyProgram layerLayout.inputWidth).map
    (fun inst => inst.ptxText.replace s!"PC_{dotLoopStart}" "DOT_LOOP")
  "\n" ++ String.intercalate "\n"
    (lines.take dotLoopStart ++ ["DOT_LOOP:"] ++ lines.drop dotLoopStart) ++ "\n"

def main (args : List String) : IO Unit := do
  let source ← IO.FS.readFile (args.headD "kernels/relu_layer.ptx")
  let lines := ((source.splitOn "\n").map (fun line => line.trimAscii.toString)).filter
    (fun line => !line.isEmpty && !(line.startsWith "//"))
  let normalized := "\n" ++ String.intercalate "\n" lines ++ "\n"
  unless (normalized.splitOn expectedSource).length == 2 do
    throw (IO.userError s!"Expected exactly one complete computational block:\n{expectedSource}")
  -- Artificial word arithmetic supplies independent full-size execution oracles.
  let sumOps : FP32.Arithmetic := ⟨fun w x acc => acc + w * x, fun a b => a + b⟩
  let fullInitial : State Register := { initial with
    regs64 := fun r => match r with
      | .weightRead => 0 | .inputRead => 8192 | .biasRead => 16380 | .outputWrite => 16384 | _ => 999
    globalMemory := fun a => if a.toNat < 4096 then some 2
      else if 8192 ≤ a.toNat && a.toNat < 12288 then some 3
      else if a = 16380 then some 1 else if a = 16388 then some 0x3f800000 else none }
  match run (bodyProgram layerLayout.inputWidth) ⟨⟨0, 0⟩, Environment.empty, sumOps⟩
      (bodySteps layerLayout.inputWidth) fullInitial with
  | none => throw (IO.userError "Full-width body execution failed.")
  | some final =>
    unless final.pc == (bodyProgram layerLayout.inputWidth).length && final.returned &&
        final.regs .column == 1024 && final.regs .result == 6145 &&
        final.globalMemory 16384 == some 6145 && final.globalMemory 16380 == some 1 &&
        final.globalMemory 16388 == some 0x3f800000 do
      throw (IO.userError "Full-width body output/frame did not match independent oracles.")
  IO.println "Complete computational block, suffix offset, 1024-column output/frame, and exact PTX source pass."

import ReluLayer.PTX.Layer
import ReluLayer.PTX.KernelExecution

private def layout : Layout := ⟨2, by decide, by decide⟩

  | .weights => 1000 | .input => 1032 | .bias => 1040 | .output => 1064
private def env : Environment :=
  { params := fun symbol => if symbol = "W_ptr" then some 1000
      else if symbol = "x_ptr" then some 1032 else if symbol = "b_ptr" then some 1040
      else if symbol = "y_ptr" then some 1064 else none
    toGlobal := fun a => if 1000 ≤ a.toNat && a.toNat < 2000 then

  { regs := fun _ => 99
    pc := 0
    regs64 := fun _ => 999
    predicates := fun _ => true
    globalMemory := fun a =>

      else if a = 32 then some 5 else if a = 36 then some 6
      else if 40 ≤ a.toNat && a.toNat < 56 then some (BitVec.ofNat 32 ((a.toNat - 40) / 4 + 7))

  · intro arg; cases arg <;> decide

  · constructor <;> decide

private def expectedSource : String :=
  let offset := (kernelSetup layerLaunch layerLayout).length + dotLoopStart
  let lines := (kernelProgram layerLaunch layerLayout).map
    (fun inst => inst.ptxText.replace s!"PC_{offset}" "DOT_LOOP")
  String.intercalate "\n" (lines.take offset ++ ["DOT_LOOP:"] ++ lines.drop offset)

def main (argv : List String) : IO Unit := do
  let source ← IO.FS.readFile (argv.headD "kernels/relu_layer.ptx")
  let body := ((source.splitOn "{").drop 1).headD ""
  let body := (body.splitOn "}").headD ""
  let lines := ((body.splitOn "\n").map (fun line => line.trimAscii.toString)).filter
    (fun line => !line.isEmpty && !(line.startsWith "//") && !(line.startsWith ".reg "))
  unless String.intercalate "\n" lines == expectedSource do
    throw (IO.userError "Complete kernel instruction list/branch label differs from the formal program.")
  -- Independent order-sensitive oracle for every thread of the small launch.
  for block in [:cfg.blocks] do
    for tid in [:cfg.threads] do
      let row := cfg.threads * block + tid
      let expected := 10 * (2 * row + 1 + 5) + (2 * row + 2 + 6) + (row + 7)
      match run (kernelProgram cfg layout) ⟨⟨BitVec.ofNat 32 tid, BitVec.ofNat 32 block⟩, env, ops⟩ (kernelSteps cfg layout) initial with
      | none => throw (IO.userError "Small-launch kernel execution failed.")
      | some final =>
        unless final.returned && final.pc == 31 && final.regs .row == BitVec.ofNat 32 row &&
            final.globalMemory (BitVec.ofNat 64 (64 + 4 * row)) == some (BitVec.ofNat 32 expected) do
          throw (IO.userError "Small-launch result did not match the independent ordered oracle.")
        for address in [:80] do
          if address != 64 + 4 * row then
            unless final.globalMemory (BitVec.ofNat 64 address) == initial.globalMemory (BitVec.ofNat 64 address) do
              throw (IO.userError "Kernel changed another word location.")
  -- Selected launch boundary rows and 1024 columns, using artificial word arithmetic.
  let sumOps : FP32.Arithmetic := ⟨fun w x acc => acc + w * x, fun a b => a + b⟩
  let weightBytes := layerLaunch.rows * layerLayout.rowStride
  let xBase := weightBytes
  let bBase := xBase + layerLayout.rowStride
  let yBase := bBase + layerLaunch.rows * fp32Bytes
  let fullArgs : Argument → Word64 := fun a => BitVec.ofNat 64 (1000 + (match a with
    | .weights => 0 | .input => xBase | .bias => bBase | .output => yBase))
  let fullEnv : Environment :=
    { params := fun symbol => if symbol = "W_ptr" then some (fullArgs .weights)
        else if symbol = "x_ptr" then some (fullArgs .input)
        else if symbol = "b_ptr" then some (fullArgs .bias)
        else if symbol = "y_ptr" then some (fullArgs .output) else none
      toGlobal := fun a => some (BitVec.ofNat 64 (a.toNat - 1000)) }
  let fullInitial : State Register := { initial with
    globalMemory := fun a =>
      if a.toNat < weightBytes then some 2
      else if a.toNat < bBase then some 3
      else if a.toNat < yBase then some 1 else some 0x3f800000 }
  for row in [0, 256, layerLaunch.rows - 1] do
    match run (kernelProgram layerLaunch layerLayout) ⟨⟨BitVec.ofNat 32 (row % layerLaunch.threads), BitVec.ofNat 32 (row / layerLaunch.threads)⟩, fullEnv, sumOps⟩ (kernelSteps layerLaunch layerLayout) fullInitial with
    | none => throw (IO.userError "Full-width kernel execution failed.")
    | some final =>
      let output := BitVec.ofNat 64 (yBase + row * fp32Bytes)
      unless final.pc == 31 && final.returned && final.regs .row == BitVec.ofNat 32 row &&
          final.regs .column == 1024 && final.regs .result == 6145 &&
          final.globalMemory output == some 6145 &&
          final.globalMemory (BitVec.ofNat 64 (bBase + row * fp32Bytes)) == some 1 &&
          final.globalMemory (output + 4) == some 0x3f800000 do
        throw (IO.userError "Full-width row/output/frame did not match independent oracles.")
  IO.println "Whole-kernel boundaries, relocated branch, all small-launch threads, 1024-column boundary rows, output/frame and exact PTX source pass."
